Hi Alicia and Tom,

Thanks again for your time earlier — good discussion on where FinLytics wants to apply embeddings for search and the initial constraints around PII retention and platform integration. Quick recap and a suggested next step to keep momentum: 

What we captured:
- Goal: Improve search recall for financial regulations and contracts; surface snippets with provenance.
- Constraints: 90-day retention for user logs; need SOC2 evidence and enterprise SSO; procurement will need an initial SOW and pricing band.
- Platform needs: VPC/private deployment likely, but want to validate a Hosted POC first for speed.

Proposed next step (demo anchor):
- 90-minute technical deep dive + ops Q&A where we can:
  1) Walk through how we’d index your documents and handle PII redaction,
  2) Show a short live query/embedding flow,
  3) Discuss deployment modes (Hosted -> Dedicated -> VPC) and costs.
- Anchor window: week of Jun 7–9. My team can hold these primary slots (PT):
  • Tue Jun 8, 10:00–11:30 PT
  • Tue Jun 8, 14:00–15:30 PT
  • Wed Jun 9, 09:00–10:30 PT
Please confirm which works best and who from your side needs to attend (security, procurement, platform/infra). If procurement needs to be looped in now, feel free to introduce them on reply — we’ll send a short MPA/estimate and an initial SOW stub.

I’m attaching a brief post-call notes PDF. I’ll also loop in a pricing lead and SE to join the demo once we lock a slot.

Next actions
- Alicia/Tom: confirm preferred slot + list of attendees (esp. security and procurement contact)
- FinLytics: indicate if there are any mandatory compliance documents to review ahead (SOC2 report, pen test summary)
- Redwood: I’ll book the time and send calendar invite + prep doc once we have attendees.

Thanks —
